{{Quote|Meet us by the Pirates' Haul cantina. Every true Corellian patriot will be there.|Nevis Kitt|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Pirates' Haul''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located within the [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] the resistance leader [[Nevis Kitt]] arranged the meeting there with [[Darmas Pollaran]], whom he falsely believed to be a friend of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
